LESSON: LISTENING FOR GIST

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.9: Listening for Gist
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening for Gist, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: where they can be found collaboratively, • make use of ......在哪儿?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio clip with prepositions and repeat saying them aloud(前边、 后边、旁边),

2. listen to a song on different classroom items (铅笔、书、黑板、椅子、桌 子、橡皮、粉笔、尺子)and sing along with peers,

3. listen to a simple narration on locations of different items, things or people in their classroom and rephrase

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio clip with prepositions and repeat saying them aloud(前边、 后边、旁边),
2. listen to a song on different classroom items (铅笔、书、黑板、椅子、桌 子、橡皮、粉笔、尺子)and sing along with peers,
3. listen to a simple narration on locations of different items, things or people in their classroom and rephrase

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening for Gist together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner exhibits self-discipline when they work collaboratively to build a word pyramid from the

vocabulary acquired on the context.

Values:
The learner develops respect when they appreciate the diverse opinions shared by their peers during the discussion on the

importance of an organised classroom environment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety in the classroom and school environment is improved as the learner becomes aware of the importance of having an

organised learning environment during the discussion.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner can link their learning to English and Kiswahili on the skills of expressing their opinions and ideas confidently

during discussions.
